faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Banka District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Banka District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Banka District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Banka, by personally or through registered post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employee of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years (as per Patna High Court guidelines), with satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment. Stenographer: requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Clerk: adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Peon/Orderly: capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees who were subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. Engagement confers no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Evening Court, Banka.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. 2661/2026.
